name: clipify
description: Use your existing Twitch channel clips in Clipify overlays and playlists.

interface.longDescription: Set up Clipify overlays, playlists and galleries using existing Twitch channel clips. Check clip synchronization and manage approved creators through your AI assistant. Clipify does not turn uploaded gameplay recordings into highlights. Choose which creators and permissions to connect; use the existing dashboard guide for streaming-software setup.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Clipify and check whether my Twitch clips are ready.
Change my overlay theme to purple.
Create a playlist using my most popular clips.
